description: This file defines an Android activity, AppSelectionActivity, which displays a searchable list of installed user applications. It allows users to select which apps to monitor via checkboxes. The file also includes a ViewModel, AppSelectionViewModel, managing UI state, app loading, filtering, and persisting selection using PreferencesRepository. Additionally, it contains a RecyclerView Adapter, AppsAdapter, for displaying app items with associated icons and checkboxes.

classes.name: AppSelectionActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying list of apps with search and selection functionality.

classes.name: AppSelectionViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing app list, search filtering, selection state, and persistence logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView and event listeners, and creates ViewModel.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts collecting UI state updates from ViewModel.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops collection of UI state updates.

methods.name: onApply
methods.description: Handles apply button click: persists selection and provides user feedback.
